test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Z, Y, X, W and V are sitting on a sofa facing north. Z is sitting immediately next to Y. X is sitting immediately next to W. V is sitting on the leftmost seat. X is at the second position from the right. Z and X are sitting together. Who is sitting at the middle position?
solution:
Given: Five person Z, Y, X, W and V. 

1) V is sitting on the leftmost seat.

2) X is at the second position from the right.

3) X is sitting immediately next to W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b635d29c9b6d059080932b9aebe7efd035b0efe33953c009c947d5f2802062c8.png] 

4) Z and X are sitting together.

5) Z is sitting immediately next to Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a487fc85c9cc89670e24a04f5ffc0b86cd91e35882a290d987dcc70fb75b672.png] 

So, Z will be sitting at the middle position.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Z"**.
